Container.Name: paperless-curator
Container.Overview: Reads OCR text from Paperless-ngx and asks an OpenAI-compatible LLM to suggest document metadata (title, tags, correspondent, document type). Applies only human-curated whitelist values, never removes tags, and never modifies document contents. Dry-run is the default; live writes require dryRun=false in config.toml AND the --live flag. Exposes no ports. OCR text is sent to the configured LLM provider. On first start it creates config.toml and whitelist.json with safe defaults if missing.

Config.Name: Data Directory
Config.Description: Holds config.toml, whitelist.json, review.json, review.md, and review-log.jsonl. config.toml and whitelist.json are created with safe defaults if missing. The worker runs as PUID:PGID (defaults 99:100, Unraid nobody:users), which matches the usual appdata ownership; the entrypoint fixes /data ownership if it is not writable.

Config.Name: Paperless API Token
Config.Description: Paperless-ngx API token. Required. Never logged or committed.

Config.Name: LLM API Key
Config.Description: API key for the OpenAI-compatible LLM endpoint. Required.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID the worker runs as. Unraid default is 99 (nobody).

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID the worker runs as. Unraid default is 100 (users).
